## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A 3-juan early-Míng commentary on the *Huángshígōng sān lüè* ([KR3b0007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3b/KR3b0007)), composed by Liú Yín in *Hóngwǔ* 4 (1371). The work provides phrase-by-phrase explanation in clear language, suitable for use as a military-classical textbook. Composition: precisely datable to 1371. The frontmatter brackets to 1371–1371.

**Abstract**

The *Sān lüè zhí jiě* is the standard early-Míng commentary on the *Sān lüè*. The bibliographic record: *Míng shǐ yìwén zhì*; SKQS *Zǐbù — Bīngjiā lèi*.
